OPERATIONAL MODUS OPERANDI:

INVESTIGATIVE ACTIONS & POLICE RECORD: On 29th January 2018, Inspector S. K. Roy of the Central Bureau of Investigation intercepted documents at PNB Brady House Branch. DSP Ramesh Varma conducted a raid on the residential premises of Gokulnath Shetty. PSI K. L. Patil recorded the initial statement of the complainant. Spot Panchnama was executed by Inspector S. K. Roy in the presence of independent witnesses.
